transcript.answer:
`apps/floor` was deleted on 2026-10-02. The external Floor engine, the standalone re-cinq/floor repo, replaced it. Lore reaches that engine only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`, and it moved over one family of assembly lines at a time (ADR-049, dated 2026-09-30). Memory records tie the removal to PRs #2431 and #2480, but I could not confirm which PR did the deletion itself.

Before the deletion, `apps/floor`'s last duties moved to the stations service and lore-api: the cron ticks, repository events, sweeps, bus housekeeping, nightly consolidation and the run page's history reads. Some things ended with it: the old walk, the single-agent task worker and watcher, and the dark-factory auto-merge evaluation.

Later the same day, Lore's own cluster agent and `ai-agents` controller stopped running. The floor installs its own controller in its own namespace.

ADR-049 lists some leftovers as follow-ups: the old line files, the node stations, the `lore-station` pod image, lore-api's claim routes, and the Terraform resources of the `lore-floor` namespace.
